responsibility: Declares the symbol nodes for D declaration attributes and attribute-like wrappers. It covers storage classes, deprecation, linkage and C++ mangling attributes, visibility, alignment, anonymous aggregates, pragmas, conditional declarations (`static if`, version/debug), static foreach expansion, mixin/compile declarations, user-defined attributes, and forwarding scopes, along with the scope-creation and member-inclusion hooks semantic analysis uses to apply these attributes to enclosed declarations.
